surface_mechanism_description: High-k dielectric deposition by ALD occurs readily on hydroxylated surfaces, such as chemical SiO2, or a hydroxylated oxynitride passivation. Uncontrolled formation of a thin interfacial oxide layer is observed if the Si is not already passivated by such a layer prior to deposition.
evidence: High-k dielectric deposition by ALD occurs readily on hydroxylated surfaces, such as chemical SiO2, or a hydroxylated oxynitride passivation. Uncontrolled formation of a thin interfacial oxide layer is observed if the Si is not already passivated by such a layer prior to deposition.
